fact: The Ministry of Local Government's digital transformation project director said on 2 November 2023 that official e-mail accounts would be created for the heads of administrative units in the municipalities within the ministry's electronic correspondence system, to replace paper correspondence, under the ministry's digital transformation strategy; the accounts were announced, not yet in use, and no count of municipalities is given.
system: منظومة التراسل الإلكتروني بالوزارة (the ministry's electronic correspondence system)

fact: The electronic correspondence system that municipal administrative units were to be brought into is the Ministry of Local Government's own, run under its digital transformation project, as stated on 2 November 2023; no funding source is stated.
system: منظومة التراسل الإلكتروني بالوزارة (the ministry's electronic correspondence system)
